title: 第13章 三千点源能！（新人求收藏！）
slug: 万界词条从基因锁词条开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

玲玲几人神色惨白的看着这一切，有人甚至已经弯腰准备呕吐了。

不过也有心理承受能力比较强的，戴眼镜的长发女生此刻拿着背包，强忍着恶心准备将丧尸脑袋装起来。

她闭着眼睛快速将丧尸脑袋放进背包后，心中一松，随后起身，却陡然一愣。

只见一只丧尸不知道从什么地方钻了出来，此刻已经到了她的身边。

长发女生看着冲过来的丧尸，双目瞪大，但是身体却站在原地一动不动。

噗！刀光一闪，丧尸脑袋顿时离开了身体。

“愣着干什么！快点！”罗兰瞥了一眼这个被吓坏的长发女生，呵斥道。

“哦哦......”长发女生一愣，猛地惊醒，心脏砰砰直跳，脑子里不由回忆起罗兰刚才那一刀的气势，带着恍惚的神色将新的丧尸头颅放进背包。

她此刻已经相信，罗兰的确能保证她们的安全。

“我们加快速度。”

罗兰瞥了一眼附近的丧尸，然后一马当先，直接快步朝着前方冲去。

很快，杀了几头丧尸之后，几人就来到了便利店。

便利店里面只有两头丧尸，此刻漫无目的的游荡在店内。

发现罗兰几人进来的动静后，立刻冲了过来，但很快被罗兰一刀一个的解决了。

将店内的威胁铲除后，罗兰将便利店的门关上，然后看着几个气喘吁吁的人。

这几个人身上，每个人身后的背包里，最少都有一颗丧尸脑袋。

“你们现在就把这些丧尸脑袋处理了，我去收集食物。”

罗兰说完，便开始用准备好的袋子装起了食物和水。

便利店里面的货架上很混乱，看起来有人早就来过了。

不过，这里面的物资依旧丰富。

等罗兰收集好食物后，玲玲几人也将丧尸大脑全部收集了一遍。

只见她们每个人都脸色苍白，地上还有呕吐过的痕迹。

“我们只发现了一个。”玲玲将擦洗干净的低等丧尸晶核递给了罗兰。

罗兰接过，数据面板顿时弹出了提示。

【低等丧尸晶核：源能物品，服用后有较小几率增强些许体质，有较大几率被丧尸病毒感染。】

【每个低等丧尸晶体，可以转化为一百源能。】

看着数据面板的提示，罗兰嘴角一动，露出一丝笑容。

“很好，你们现在去收集食物，我恢复体力。”

Lingling and others looked at all this with pale expressions, and some even bent over and were about to vomit.

However, there are also those who have stronger psychological endurance. The long-haired girl wearing glasses is holding a backpack at the moment, holding back her nausea and preparing to put the zombie's head on it.

She closed her eyes and quickly put the zombie's head into her backpack. She felt relieved, then stood up, but was suddenly stunned.

I saw a zombie coming out of nowhere, and it was already next to her.

The long-haired girl looked at the zombies rushing over, her eyes widened, but her body stood motionless.

puff!The sword flashed, and the zombie's head immediately left the body.

"What are you doing standing still! Hurry up!" Roland glanced at the frightened long-haired girl and scolded.

"Oh..." The long-haired girl was stunned and suddenly woke up. Her heart was pounding. Her mind could not help but recall the momentum of Roland's knife just now. She put the new zombie head into her backpack with a dazed expression.

She now believed that Roland could indeed guarantee their safety.

"Let's speed it up."

Roland glanced at the nearby zombies, then took the lead and rushed forward quickly.

Soon, after killing a few zombies, a few people came to the convenience store.

There were only two zombies in the convenience store, wandering aimlessly in the store at the moment.

After noticing the movement of Roland and the others coming in, they immediately rushed over, but were quickly killed by Roland one by one.

After eliminating the threats in the store, Roland closed the door of the convenience store and looked at several panting people.

There is at least one zombie head on each of these people and in the backpack behind them.

"You guys should deal with these zombie heads now, and I'll go collect the food."

After Roland finished speaking, he began to fill the prepared bags with food and water.

The shelves inside the convenience store were in chaos, and it looked like someone had been there a long time ago.

However, the materials here are still abundant.

After Roland collected the food, Lingling and others also collected all the zombie brains.

Each of them looked pale, and there were traces of vomiting on the ground.

"We only found one." Lingling handed the cleaned low-level zombie crystal core to Roland.

Roland took it, and a prompt popped up on the data panel.

[Low-level zombie crystal core: a source energy item. After taking it, there is a small chance of strengthening the body a little, and there is a high chance of being infected by the zombie virus.】

[Each low-level zombie crystal can be converted into one hundred source energy.】

Looking at the prompts on the data panel, Roland's mouth moved and a smile appeared.

"Very well, you go collect food now while I regain my strength."
